name: Alarico (All Night Set) - Limited 500 Tickets
description: Alarico, a techno artist, will perform an all-night set at Gare Porto. The event is limited to 500 tickets.
longDescription:
Alarico, an Italian techno artist, is scheduled to play an all-night set at Gare Porto. The event is limited to 500 tickets, with the first release priced at €30.00, which are currently sold out.

The performance is set for Friday, November 6, 2026, starting at 11:00 PM and running until 6:00 AM. Alarico's sets are known for their raw and wild nature, combining slick minimalism with gritty textures to create an organized chaos.

Gare Porto is located at Rua da Madeira 182, 4000-330 Porto, Portugal. The event is organized by Gare Porto.
